title: Existence of a QIND-CCA2 Scheme Not Upgradable to QAE
summary: A prior QIND-CCA2-versus-QAE separation is repairable by changing decryption; the unresolved question is whether any separation resists such a decryption-only upgrade.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether there exists a quantum encryption scheme that satisfies $\mathsf{QIND\text{-}CCA2}$ security but cannot be upgraded to $\mathsf{QAE}$ solely by modifying its decryption function.

scope.domain: Quantum cryptography for symmetric encryption and authenticated encryption.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether there exists such a scheme that cannot be upgraded to QAE solely by modifying its decryption function.

progress.summary: The source lists this as a final open question in its discussion, asking for a QIND-CCA2-secure scheme whose failure to achieve QAE cannot be fixed by changing only decryption.
citation_labels: Gorjan Alagic et al., Unforgeable Quantum Encryption
